summary: Registered nurse with four years on a busy medical-surgical floor and two in the emergency department.

workExperienceSection.workDescription:
• Care for 4 to 6 patients a shift in a 60-bed emergency department that sees 250 visits a day
• Triage walk-in patients using the Emergency Severity Index and start sepsis protocols within the first hour
• Precept 2 new graduate nurses a year through their 12-week orientation

• Cared for 5 patients a shift on a 32-bed unit, mostly after abdominal and orthopedic surgery
• Led the unit’s falls committee, which cut patient falls by 40% in a year with hourly rounding
• Served as charge nurse on night shift twice a week from 2022
• Took vital signs, drew blood and helped with mobility for up to 10 patients a shift while in nursing school

educationSection.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

awardsSection.awardOrg: Board of Certification for Emergency Nursing

skillsSection.skillDetails: Triage, IV insertion, sepsis protocols, wound care, telemetry monitoring

volunteerExperienceSection.volunteerDescription: • Staff a free Saturday clinic once a month, giving vaccines and checking blood pressure for uninsured patients
